origin.description: Split y ~ x | g into panels and pad the numeric limits.
origin.details: The first conditioning variable changes from panel to panel before the next one. A numeric range grows by 7 percent on each side. Matplotlib draws the points.
origin.value: The panel coordinates and the padded limits.
origin.example:
p <- xyplot(mpg ~ wt | cyl, data = mtcars)
cat(p$x.limits, p$y.limits, "\n")
